name: A Normal Trip to the Ice Cream Parlor
source:
It's summer, and it's extremely hot! You want some ice cream, but there's something weird going on...

Totally not commentary on a certain store with low standards!

[From [url=https://wondergamer101.itch.io/a-normal-trip-to-the-ice-cream-parlor] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
夏天到了，天氣熱得不得了！你想吃冰淇淋，卻發現有些奇怪的事情正在發生……

絕對不是在評論某家標準很低的店！
